item.title: Latest ‘Phantom of the Opera’ blends fresh and familiar at Detroit Opera House
item.description: But even after more than 40 years, the most definitive work of Andrew Lloyd Webber's celebrated career continues to transform and refresh, as evidenced by the current touring production at the Detroit Opera House through Feb. 15.

item.title: How a California tribe is confronting the Trump administration to claim their historic rights to a river
item.description: As Pacific Gas and Electric Co., seeks to decommission its Potter Valley hydroelectric project, the Round Valley tribal coalition is confronting the Trump administration over the future of the Eel River.

item.title: VanSlooten records double double for No. 12 Michigan State women in 81-70 win over Penn State
item.description: Grace VanSlooten recorded her fifth double-double of the season, Jalyn Brown scored 16 points and Rashunda Jones added 14 in No. 12 Michigan State’s come-from-behind 81-70 win over Penn State on Saturday afternoon.

item.title: North Farmington’s Megan Keller has three points in 5-0 win over Finland team coming off stomach virus
item.description: Every goal still feels special for Hilary Knight, no matter how many USA Hockey’s most decorated woman has scored in her record-setting career. Saturday night was no different for the 36-year-old appearing in her U.S. women’s hockey-best fifth Olympics.

item.title: Photo gallery from the 2026 Oakland County Boys Swim Championships in Royal Oak
item.description: The Oakland County Boys Swim Championships were held Saturday, Feb. 7, 2026 at Royal Oak Middle School, where Detroit Catholic Central taking home top honors.

item.title: Jeremy Fears’ 26 points and 15 assists help No. 10 Michigan State beat No. 5 Illinois 85-82 in OT
item.description: Jeremy Fears scored 26 points, including a tiebreaking three-point play with 1:47 left in overtime, and had 15 assists to help No. 10 Michigan State hold on for an 85-82 win over No. 5 Illinois on Saturday night.

item.title: Detroit Catholic Central repeats as Oakland County boys swim champs
item.description: Detroit Catholic Central ruled the pool at last year's Oakland County Boys Swim Championships, but didn't finish its season the way it wanted to at state finals.
